hypothesis: Training-only complementary coverage can rescue source-positive hosts missed by prevalence at the same two-test budget, including held-out host groups.
endpoint: Original source aggregate MLC > 0; missing MLC stays unknown. Not productive infection, cocktail efficacy or treatment outcome.
evidence_scope: Already-inspected development data. No independent validation or promotion claim. Do not pool overlapping panels or methods as independent observations.

selection.objective: At each step maximize the count of distinct training hosts with an observed positive among the selected candidates. Use all training hosts, retaining incomplete hosts' known-positive contributions; unknown pairs do not count as negatives or positives.
selection.fixed_panel: Select one ordered pair per training split, used unchanged for every target host.
selection.low_prevalence_definition: Strictly below the median of the 94 smoothed training prevalence rates, separately per split; descriptive, never an eligibility filter.

comparator_ties: Exact expectation over uniform permutations within exact-score ties, matching saved results; no lexical score perturbation.

evaluation.primary: All complete-panel test hosts, including source-all-negative hosts; separate results per panel.
evaluation.secondary: Primary-panel validation hosts and eligible-complete-host summaries; no selection using these labels.
evaluation.incomplete_panels: Exclude whole host from primary summaries, retain known-positive and all-unknown-positive bounds separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 paired held-out host-group percentile bootstrap draws per partition; fixed fitted comparators and panel. Pointwise descriptive 95% intervals, no significance or independence claim.

stability.procedure: Resample training groups uniformly with replacement, retain all member hosts and their multiplicities; reselect the two candidates using weighted known-positive coverage and weighted prevalence. Report selection frequency, not independent replication.

candidate_diagnostics: For all 94 candidates report observed training prevalence and extra known-positive coverage beyond the selected first candidate, plus target known-positive coverage on first-candidate-negative hosts. Target unknown-anchor hosts remain unresolved. These target diagnostics never choose a candidate or amend the frozen pair.
case_rule: Retain NILS53, NILS78, AL505 regardless of result, with all selected and comparator top-two source readings. Retain every rescue and newly missed host with original source row/column links. No test-selected biological mechanism claim.

source_matrix.attribution: Gaborieau, Vaysset, Tesson et al.; DOI 10.1038/s41564-024-01832-5; primary archive Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13831957. See paired_data_reuse_review.v1.json; source matrix is fetched locally, not republished here.
